affine_initialization.reason: Initial map positions from the labelled half-degree crossings.

seed_provenance: Numbered five-minute rulers on this edition and long continuous interior graticule strokes. Alternating numbered rules and additional interior line observations withheld. Scale-obscured labels omitted.
omitted_crossing_note: At 78 degrees east, 31.5 degrees north the engraved parallel is legible, but dense hachuring obscures the meridian at the putative crossing. Excluded from two-coordinate controls. Other independent meridian observations retained.
crop_review_note: Zero inward offset at the engraved inner frame. All four corners and sides inspected.
